description: Implementation of NetworkStatusObserver class for managing network connectivity and security tokens in the TTS plugin of WPEFramework.

classes.name: NetworkStatusObserver
classes.description: Singleton class that observes network status and manages security tokens.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkStatusObserver.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, reading environment variables or config files as needed.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the device is connected to the internet, establishing RPC connection if necessary.

methods.name: onConnectionStatusChangedEventHandler
methods.description: Handles network connection status change events.
